annotations.annotation: EDIT: Due to errors during vendor calibration, there were issues with the onboard-calculated O2 products during this deployment. The calibration files have been corrected, and the O2 values derived using the external OOI Stern-Volmer-Uchida algorithm [DO from Phase (L1 product) and DO from Phase - Corrected (L2 product)] should be considered valid. The onboard-calculated Stern-Volmer values [DO from Onboard Calculation (L1) and DO from Onboard Calculation - Corrected (L2)] should NOT be used during this time range.
